name: dojo
description: Surplus-quota training loop over the ax graph - the agent burns the remaining 5h/7d plan-quota window on self-improvement: locking pending verdicts, filling briefs, backtesting routing classes, minting proposals, running worktree experiments, and drafting upstream issue reports. Triggers when the user says "/dojo", "enter the dojo", "dojo time", "train overnight", "burn my surplus quota", "dream mode" (legacy name), or invokes /loop /dojo. Requires ax (axctl) on PATH and the local SurrealDB runn
author: Necmttn
summary_zh: 利用剩余套餐额度让智能体持续自我训练的自动循环，适合夜间批量补全任务、回测路由并验证改进方案。
